AND target = ?');\n        $stmt->execute([$id, $activeName]);\n        foreach ($stmt->fetchAll() as $row) {\n            $newRemaining = (int) $row['remaining_rounds'] - 1;\n            if ($newRemaining > 0) {\n                $upd = $this->pdo->prepare('UPDATE combat_conditions SET remaining_rounds = ? WHERE id = ?');\n                $upd->execute([$newRemaining, $row['id']]);\n            } else {\n                $del = $this->pdo->prepare('DELETE FROM combat_conditions WHERE id = ?');\n                $del->execute([$row['id']]);\n            }\n        }\n\n        $upd = $this->pdo->prepare('UPDATE combat_sessions SET round = ?, turn_index = ? WHERE id = ?');\n        $upd->execute([$newRound, $newIndex, $id]);\n\n        $session['round'] = $newRound;\n        $session['turn_index'] = $newIndex;\n        $session['conditions'] = $this->getConditionsMap($id);\n        foreach ($session['order'] as $combatant) {\n            $name = $combatant['name'];\n            if (!isset($session['conditions'][$name])) {\n                $session['conditions'][$name] = [];\n            }\n        }\n\n        return $session;\n    }\n\n    public function createMonster(array $data): bool\n    {\n        try {\n            $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare('INSERT INTO compendium_monsters (slug, name, cr, armor_class, hit_points, tags_json) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)');\n            $stmt->execute([\n                $data['slug'],\n                $data['name'],\n                $data['cr'],\n                $data['armor_class'],\n                $data['hit_points'],\n                json_encode($data['tags'] ?? AND id = ?');\n            $stmt->execute([$campaignId, $encounterId]);\n            $row = $stmt->fetch();\n            if (!$row) {\n                $this->pdo->exec('ROLLBACK');\n\n                return null;\n            }\n\n            $order = $this->resolveEncounterOrder($campaignId, $encounterId, $row['combatants_json']);\n            $count = count($order);\n            $turnIndex = (int) $row['turn_index'];\n            $round = (int) $row['round'];\n            $newTurnIndex = $turnIndex;\n            $newRound = $round;\n            if ($count > 0) {\n                $newTurnIndex = $turnIndex + 1;\n                if ($newTurnIndex >= $count) {\n                    $newTurnIndex = 0;\n                    $newRound++;\n                }\n                $activeId = $this->combatantIdentifier($order[$newTurnIndex] ?? null);\n                if ($activeId !== null) {\n                    $this->expirePlayCampaignEncounterConditions($campaignId, $encounterId, $activeId);\n                }\n            }\n\n            $upd = $this->pdo->prepare('UPDATE play_campaign_encounters SET round = ?, turn_index = ? AND id = ?');\n            $stmt->execute([$campaignId, $encounterId]);\n            $row = $stmt->fetch();\n            $entries = json_decode($row['order_json'] ?? '[]', true, 512, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);\n\n            $current = array_splice($entries, $turnIndex, 1)[0];\n            array_splice($entries, $newIndex, 0, [$current]);\n\n            $this->saveEncounterOrder($campaignId, $encounterId, $entries);\n            $upd = $this->pdo->prepare('UPDATE play_campaign_encounters SET turn_index = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND id = ?');\n            $upd->execute([$newIndex, $campaignId, $encounterId]);\n            $this->pdo->exec('COMMIT');\n\n            return [\n                'order' => $this->hydrateEncounterOrderEntries($campaignId, $encounterId, $entries, $row['combatants_json']),\n            ];\n        } catch (\\Throwable $e) {\n            $this->pdo->exec('ROLLBACK');\n            throw $e;\n        }\n    }\n\n    public function damagePlayCampaignEncounterCombatant(string $campaignId, string $encounterId, string $target, int $amount): ?array\n    {\n        $monster = $this->getPlayCampaignEncounterMonster($campaignId, $encounterId, $target);\n        if ($monster !== null) {\n            $hpBefore = $monster['hp_current'];\n            $hpAfter = max(0, $hpBefore - $amount);\n            $this->updatePlayCampaignEncounterMonsterHp($campaignId, $encounterId, $target, $hpAfter);\n\n            return [\n                'target' => $target,\n                'hp_before' => $hpBefore,\n                'hp_after' => $hpAfter,\n                'damage' => $amount,\n            ];\n        }\n\n        if ($this->isPlayCampaignEncounterCombatant($campaignId, $encounterId, $target)) {\n            $hp = $this->getPlayCampaignMemberHp($campaignId, $target);\n            if ($hp === null) {\n                return null;\n            }\n            $hpBefore AND id = ?');\n            $stmt->execute([$campaignId, $encounterId]);\n            $row = $stmt->fetch();\n            if (!$row) {\n                $this->pdo->exec('ROLLBACK');\n\n                return null;\n            }\n\n            $order = $this->resolveEncounterOrder($campaignId, $encounterId, $row['combatants_json']);\n            $count = count($order);\n            $turnIndex = (int) $row['turn_index'];\n            $round = (int) $row['round'];\n            $newTurnIndex = $turnIndex;\n            $newRound = $round;\n            if ($count > 0) {\n                $newTurnIndex = $turnIndex + 1;\n                if ($newTurnIndex >= $count) {\n                    $newTurnIndex = 0;\n                    $newRound++;\n                }\n                $activeId = $this->combatantIdentifier($order[$newTurnIndex] ?? null);\n                if ($activeId !== null) {\n                    $this->expirePlayCampaignEncounterConditions($campaignId, $encounterId, $activeId);\n                }\n            }\n\n            $upd = $this->pdo->prepare('UPDATE play_campaign_encounters SET round = ?, turn_index = ? AND id = ?');\n            $stmt->execute([$campaignId, $encounterId]);\n            $row = $stmt->fetch();\n            $entries = json_decode($row['order_json'] ?? '[]', true, 512, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);\n\n            $current = array_splice($entries, $turnIndex, 1)[0];\n            array_splice($entries, $newIndex, 0, [$current]);\n\n            $this->saveEncounterOrder($campaignId, $encounterId, $entries);\n            $upd = $this->pdo->prepare('UPDATE play_campaign_encounters SET turn_index = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND id = ?');\n            $upd->execute([$newIndex, $campaignId, $encounterId]);\n            $this->pdo->exec('COMMIT');\n\n            return [\n                'order' => $this->hydrateEncounterOrderEntries($campaignId, $encounterId, $entries, $row['combatants_json']),\n            ];\n        } catch (\\Throwable $e) {\n            $this->pdo->exec('ROLLBACK');\n            throw $e;\n        }\n    }\n\n    public function damagePlayCampaignEncounterCombatant(string $campaignId, string $encounterId, string $target, int $amount): ?array\n    {\n        $monster = $this->getPlayCampaignEncounterMonster($campaignId, $encounterId, $target);\n        if ($monster !== null) {\n            $hpBefore = $monster['hp_current'];\n            $hpAfter = max(0, $hpBefore - $amount);\n            $this->updatePlayCampaignEncounterMonsterHp($campaignId, $encounterId, $target, $hpAfter);\n\n            return [\n                'target' => $target,\n                'hp_before' => $hpBefore,\n                'hp_after' => $hpAfter,\n                'damage' => $amount,\n            ];\n        }\n\n        if ($this->isPlayCampaignEncounterCombatant($campaignId, $encounterId, $target)) {\n            $hp = $this->getPlayCampaignMemberHp($campaignId, $target);\n            if ($hp === null) {\n                return null;\n            }\n            $hpBefore It is\ndeliberately self-contained: a single SQLite database, a handful of domain\nclasses, and Symfony `HttpFoundation` + `Routing` for HTTP handling.\n\n## Quick start\n\nInstall dependencies (already vendored in this workspace):\n\n```bash\ncomposer install\n```\n\nStart the server in the foreground on the port defined by the `PORT`\nenvironment variable:\n\n```bash\nPORT=8080 ./run.sh\n```\n\n`run.sh` first calls `reset.php` to clear legacy JSON files and truncate the\nSQLite data tables, then launches PHP's built-in server bound to\n`127.0.0.1:$PORT` using `index.php` as the router script.\n\nVerify the server is up:\n\n```bash\ncurl http://127.0.0.1:8080/health\n# Expected: {\"ok\":true}\n```\n\nReset persisted state:\n\n```bash\ncurl -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1/storage/reset\n# Expected: {\"ok\":true,\"schema_version\":1}\n```\n\n## Project layout\n\n```\n.\n├── index.php              # Builds a `Request` from globals once, then derives a `RequestContext` from\n   it and creates a `UrlMatcher`.\n5. Matches the incoming `Request` against the route collection.\n6. Calls the matched controller callable with `($request, $parameters)`.\n7. Catches `App\\Http\\HttpException` → JSON error response with the carried\n   status code (400/401/403/409), then `ResourceNotFoundException` → 404 and\n   `MethodNotAllowedException` → 405.\n8. Controller methods are\nordinary public methods on `Controllers`; they are registered as\n`[$controllers, 'methodName']` callables.
